gloss: tip of a brush; writing style

definitions.gloss: tip of a brush; brush point
definitions.explanation: The physical tip or point of a writing brush or paintbrush.

definitions.gloss: writing style; way of writing; penmanship
definitions.explanation: One's manner or style of writing, including the way someone expresses themselves in written form.

⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧{筆先|ふでさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧な⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧ (brush, writing) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (tip, point). Sense 1 is the literal meaning referring to the physical tip of a brush or pen. Sense 2 is figurative, referring to someone's writing style or way of expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆先|ふでさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ — to shape the brush tip
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{筆先|ふでさき} — sharp writing style
- {筆先|ふでさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}る→鈍る：14469_niburu⟧ — one's writing becomes dull

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {筆|ふで}つき — handwriting style, penmanship
- ⟦{文体|ぶんたい}→文体：12931_buntai⟧ — writing style, literary style
- {穂先|ほさき} — tip of a brush (physical, more specific)
